text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Trainer.
I have returned.
choice_data_list: Good work. That was a good race.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
I felt a surging, intense wind.
Graded stakes races truly are on another level...

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
This is surely the spring breeze of growth.
What we gained from this race... is immense.

Leaving behind magnificent results, Yamanin Zephyr
splendidly made a name for herself as one who would
lead the next generation of the mile division.
And as if competing with one another—

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Tokai Teio is in the lead!
Tokai Teio takes a commanding lead!
The runner in second closes in, but can't pass her! She's so, so strong!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
1st place goes to Tokai Teio!!
A majestic run across the line by Tokai Teio!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Took the lead early at the 4th corner!
After that, she pushed all the way through to victory!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text: An undefeated Satsuki Sho Umamusume is born!!
(WAAAAAAAHH!!)

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
"...That was a gale of majesty, wasn't it?
Truly splendid, Tokai Teio-san—"

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Now, Trainer.
Let us summon the next gust of wind.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
We must not stand stagnant.
Even if buffeted by the winds of the Ox,
into the fiercer torrent we go—!

Drawing inspiration from Tokai Teio as well,
Yamanin Zephyr is raring to go.
Then, riding on this momentum—
choice_data_list: Next, let's aim for the Aoi Stakes.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
"The Aoi Stakes... It's a 1,200m sprint.
Will you find an even greater gale here?"

I nod. Now is the time to once again
thoroughly polish her greatest weapon: speed.
And then—!
choice_data_list: Next up, it's a G1 race!
Next up, we're taking on a G1 race!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: ! Finally...!!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
"The wind picks up.
From a gentle breeze to a howling gale. And then—"

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Fufu.
...I'm looking forward to it. Very much so.
